items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_eval_eq_zero
items.type: {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [Fintype K] [Field K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (h : f.totalDegree < (Fintype.card K - 1) * Fintype.card σ) : ∑ x, (MvPolynomial.eval x) f = 0

items.name: char_dvd_card_solutions_of_fintype_sum_lt
